meta.source: Scottish Vacant and Derelict Land Survey 2024 site register (revised July 2026)
meta.note: Official register of DERELICT LAND, not of abandoned buildings. It records ground that has been previously developed and needs rehabilitation, which includes cleared plots and sites already being built on. Trimmed to entries the register flags as still having buildings, plus sites of half a hectare or more; smaller plots were dropped because they read as gaps between houses rather than places. Coordinates mark the site area, not a building. Off by default for that reason.
